visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a silver hair clip is framed in an eye-level medium close-up against an indoor background. She wears a white fuzzy cardigan over a dark top and speaks directly to the camera with a calm facial expression. Behind her, a beige wall, a doorway, and a white bed are visible under soft, even lighting. (2) The woman continues to speak, but her facial expression becomes increasingly somber as her eyes glisten with tears. The camera remains static, and the background environment is unchanged, maintaining a focused and intimate atmosphere as she gestures slightly with her head. (3) The woman's emotional expression reaches a peak as she laughs and cries simultaneously, wipes her nose with her finger, and looks upward. She maintains a wide smile despite her tearful eyes. White captions appear consistently at the bottom center of the frame throughout all phases.
